claims.text: Anthropic is in talks to acquire Israeli AI startup Decart, in a deal Bloomberg and Calcalist independently reported at roughly $6 billion as of 13 August 2026
claims.reasoning: Bloomberg (13 Aug, own 'people familiar with the matter' sourcing) and Calcalist (13 Aug article mrrffazk1, own byline/sourcing, published the same week) both report the $6B figure with distinct sourcing language; neither text cites the other as its source for the figure itself. Downgraded from the verifier's initial framing per the falsifier's finding; also noting for internal record (not in the article body, which already states this is Calcalist's account) that Calcalist's separate, contemporaneous claim of a SpaceX-Decart deal was publicly denied by Elon Musk, a relevant single-outlet reliability caveat for this specific story.

claims.text: Decart, founded in 2023 and based in Tel Aviv, builds software that improves AI chip efficiency plus two 'world models' -- Lucy, for real-time video editing, and Oasis, which generates simulated environments for training robotics and autonomous-driving systems; it raised a $300 million Series B in May 2026 at a valuation of about $4 billion, up from $3.1 billion in August 2025, with Nvidia among the investors in that round
